messages:
kevin (Finance): Heads up  discovered a late-adjustment invoice from VendorX that reduces billed revenue for April by $6,125. Uploaded docs: s3://redwood-bills/vendorx/INV-VX-082.pdf :file_folder:
maya (Billing Ops): Paste the invoice lines? Need to confirm whether its a missing passthrough or post-bill credit.
kevin (Finance): From PDF: ```
Line: Dedicated capacity Apr 1-30 | $12,250.00
Line: Contractual vendor rebate | -$6,125.00 | (appears as post-bill credit)
Net due: $6,125.00
```
sophie (FP&A): Impact: $6,125 reduces recognized revenue in April (close posted). Below $10k restatement threshold but >$5k so we should still do a prior-period adjusting journal and note in pack.
oliver (Controller): Agreed. Approve prior-period adjusting JE. Provide GL mapping and attach vendor rebate contract and ticket.
maya (Billing Ops): Root cause looks like vendor rebate feed was ingested after AR run; billing engine marks it as post-bill adjustment. I'll open ticket BILL-9633 and flag for backfill.
billing-bot (billing-bot): New ticket created: BILL-9633  VendorX rebate arrived post-AR run; requires backfill. Link: https://tickets.internal/BILL-9633
kevin (Finance): Proposed JE to post in April: debit 4002 Dedicated Revenue $6,125.00; credit 2105 Customer Credits $6,125.00. Memo: "VendorX rebate post-bill credit - INV-VX-082". I'll queue in NetSuite and attach docs.
sophie (FP&A): Also recommend a $8k conservative bump to April unbilled accruals to cover similar late rebates while we backfill. I'll update the close pack note.
oliver (Controller): Approve JE mapping. Post by EOD tomorrow and include ticket BILL-9633 and vendor contract. If we see >3 similar late rebates this month, escalate to finance leadership.
maya (Billing Ops): Will generate credit memo CM-2026-037 and request billing backfill. Adding a temporary check to the ingest pipeline to alert for rebates arriving after AR cutover.
kevin (Finance): Thanks  will post JE and ping for sign-off. Closing note: track billing ticket count daily until patch verified.
